messages:
marco: Quick doc bug: function-calling examples are inconsistent. OpenAPI shows `functions: [{name, parameters: {type: 'object', properties: {...}}}]` but the JS + Python snippets pass `functions` as an array of shallow objects (name + description) without the parameters schema. Quickstart test for the function-calling demo fails at runtime because the runtime expects the schema to be present for type coercion. cc @henri @molly

henri: thanks for flagging. Which files are impacted?

marco: docs/api/functions.md, docs/samples/functions_openapi.json, snippets/js/functions_example.md, snippets/python/functions_example.md. The sample OpenAPI `components` schema is correct, but the inline example for the endpoint omits the `parameters` object.

molly: that's awkward. I think when we last edited the docs we split the schema into components but forgot to update the endpoint example. Users following the quickstart only see the endpoint example and miss the schema.

linter-bot: CI: sample-validator error in docs/samples/functions_openapi.json line 57: missing required field `parameters` for function object in example.

henri: plan: update the endpoint example to include the full `parameters` entry for each function, and adjust JS/Python snippets to include the same shape. Also add a short note in functions.md: "When passing functions inline to the endpoint, include a `parameters` JSON Schema to enable correct argument validation and coercion."

marco: can you add minimal examples? For the JS snippet show:
```js
functions: [
  {
    name: "get_weather",
    description: "Get weather for a location",
    parameters: {
      type: "object",
      properties: {
        location: { type: "string" },
        units: { type: "string", enum: ["metric","imperial"] }
      },
      required: ["location"]
    }
  }
]
```

molly: perfect. I'll make the same update in python and the OpenAPI example (inline JSON under the /v1/chat endpoint). Also add a one-line migration note: "If your integration previously omitted `parameters`, add a minimal JSON Schema to avoid runtime casting surprises."

ci-bot: Preview build queued after push.

linter-bot: CI: docs-lint passed for YAML and JSON formatting. Sample validator now passes locally.

molly: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5077 - branch `docs/functions-params-example-3965432100`. Requesting review from @henri and @marco.

henri: reviewing now. Also add a short example showing streaming SSE chunks where the `function_call` events contain `arguments` fragments (so readers understand streaming assembly).

marco: good call. Add a short SSE snippet like:
```
data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"role":"assistant","function_call":{"name":"get_weather"}}}]}
data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"function_call":{"arguments":"{\"location\": \"SFO\"}"}}}]}
```

molly: added SSE example and a brief note about assembling `arguments` across stream chunks. CI green.

ci-bot: Preview deployed: https://deploy.preview.redwood.ai/docs/5077.

henri: looks good, merging now.

molly: merged and added changelog: "docs: ensure function-calling examples include parameters JSON Schema; clarify streaming assembly of function_call.arguments"

marco: verified quickstart function-calling demo works with the updated snippets. Closing thread.
